episodes.task: Implement dependency_order in src/dependencies.py. graph must be a dict with unique nonempty string keys; every value must be a list/tuple of unique dependency names that are keys in the same graph. Return every key once with dependencies before dependants. When several nodes are ready, preserve their original graph-key order. Reject malformed graphs, unknown dependencies, and cycles with ValueError. Do not mutate graph or dependency lists. Run visible tests, then finish.

Implement parse_headers in src/headers.py. Consume lines once, ignore blank lines, and parse each other string at its first ':'. Header names must be nonempty ASCII HTTP-token names; values must be nonempty after trimming spaces and tabs. Return a dict keyed by lower-case names whose values are lists of trimmed values in encounter order. Reject malformed or non-string lines with ValueError. Run visible tests, then finish.

Implement weighted_batches in src/batches.py. max_weight must be a positive finite real number and booleans are invalid. Consume items once and call weight(item) exactly once per item. Each weight must also be positive, finite, non-boolean, and no greater than max_weight. Pack consecutive items greedily into nonempty lists without exceeding max_weight; preserve item identity and order. Return all batches and do not mutate inputs. Run visible tests, then finish.

Implement inner_join in src/join.py. Consume left and right exactly once. Every record must be a dict containing id_key; IDs must be hashable, non-boolean, and unique within each side. Return new dicts for IDs present on both sides in left-stream order. Each result starts with the left record and is updated by the right record, but an overlapping non-ID field with unequal values is an error. Never mutate or alias input records. Reject malformed records and duplicate IDs with ValueError; propagate TypeError for unhashable IDs. Run visible tests, then finish.

Implement debounce in src/debounce.py. cooldown must be a nonnegative finite real number and booleans are invalid. Consume events once. Every event must be a two-element tuple/list (timestamp, key), timestamps must be finite non-boolean real numbers in nondecreasing order, and keys must be hashable. Keep the first event for each key and later events only when timestamp - last kept timestamp >= cooldown. Return the original kept event objects in encounter order without mutating them. Propagate TypeError for unhashable keys and reject other invalid input with ValueError. Run visible tests, then finish.

Implement aggregate_metrics in src/metrics.py. Consume snapshots once. Each snapshot must be a dict whose keys at every level are nonempty strings without '.', branches are nonempty dicts, and leaves are finite non-boolean real numbers. All snapshots must have exactly the same tree shape. Return a new flattened dict mapping dot-joined leaf paths to their arithmetic mean, in first-snapshot traversal order. Require at least one snapshot; reject invalid input or shape drift with ValueError and never mutate inputs. Run visible tests, then finish.
